decisions.statement: A line carries the property worked out whole, so a reader reads no second page.
A line says what the declaration says and what the property's own page says.
The lines are sorted, so a property that changes moves one line.
A page type carrying no property has a body with no line.
A line written here and a line read back here are the same property.

definition: everything it takes to work with a page type, as the file beside it holds that
